title: adb network connect initiated
description: The ADB client was used to connect to a network target. If this host is not a development machine, treat as suspicious: 'adb connect' to a TV is the first step of network-ADB takeover.

title: ADB device attached: 192.168.1.64:5555 (unauthorized)
description: A device appeared in 'adb devices'. Confirm it is an approved debugging target; 'unauthorized' status means the TV is prompting (good) — repeated entries mean someone keeps trying (investigate).

title: SSDP sweep/anomaly from 203.0.113.200
description: 25 distinct destinations within 10s (threshold 25). High-rate or fan-out SSDP from one source is consistent with a network discovery sweep (typical first stage of smart-TV targeting) or SSDP reflection abuse. Identify the host and verify the activity.
